note: Machine-readable form of SOURCE_ARCHIVE.md. Intended input for a checkEngineProvenance Gradle task. Every license field was read from the LICENSE file in the pinned clone, not from a repository badge.

tiers.ADAPT: May be adapted with attribution after a per-file licence check. Adapted files carry an SPDX line and an origin comment.
tiers.ALGORITHM: Algorithms and parameters may be reimplemented. No code, shader text or constant table copied verbatim.
tiers.ORACLE: Used only to generate test fixtures and expected values. Never shipped, never linked.
tiers.STUDY: Read for architecture and behaviour. Nothing derived enters the tree.
tiers.EXCLUDED: Licence forbids reuse, or there is no licence. Mood-board and mathematics research only.

sources.name: google/swissgl
sources.role: Primary GLES 3.0 simulation reference: texture-backed state histories, fragment-shader GPGPU, deterministic seeds, instanced particle rendering.
sources.attribution: Apache-2.0: licence text, copyright notice, upstream NOTICE if present, and a statement of changes in each modified file. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.
sources.notes: WebGL2 shading language is GLES 3.0. Port the kernels, not the JavaScript wrapper.

sources.name: markusfisch/ShaderEditor
sources.role: Android shader lifecycle, ping-pong backbuffers, wallpaper service, resolution choices, low-battery throttling.
sources.attribution: MIT: copyright line and licence text travel with any copied portion.

sources.name: PavelDoGreat/WebGL-Fluid-Simulation
sources.role: Advection, pressure projection, splat, bloom, format fallback.
modifications: Sim-space coordinates, boundary sampling helpers, grid-scale Jacobi, capsule emitters with velocity blending implemented clean-room from published literature.
sources.attribution: Already recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
sources.notes: Already partially ported. V2 consolidates the shared infrastructure rather than re-porting.

sources.name: QC20/Colourful-Attraction
sources.role: Basis for the first signature scene: GPU particles morphing between velocity fields without resetting particle state.
sources.attribution: MIT: copyright line and licence text with any copied portion.
sources.notes: Zero stars, and the GitHub description terminates mid-sentence in an apparent leaked authoring prompt. Verify the shader maths independently; adapt the GLSL, not the application shell.

sources.name: kevinraymond/fosfora
sources.role: Architecture reference: lock-free audio delivery, multi-resolution analysis, HDR layering, data-driven effects, modulation, audio textures.
sources.attribution: None required while nothing is copied.
sources.notes: The plan lists this for adaptation, but the runtime is Rust/wgpu and nothing is portable. Algorithms must be independently validated. Dual-licensed at the user's option.

sources.name: projectM-visualizer/projectm
sources.role: Retained legacy MilkDrop scene adapter. Not the architecture for new visuals.
sources.attribution: LGPL-2.1: dynamic linking, licence notice, and corresponding source of the modified library. Patch and build recipe are in tools/; binaries are produced by .github/workflows/native-libs.yml.
sources.notes: Separate remediation track. Shipped .so files are 4 KB page-aligned while release.yml gates on 16384, and the JNI binary predates a 2026-08-11 fix to pm_jni.c.
